product.title: Ocean Parasailing Adventure In Fort Lauderdale, FL

description.text: Fly high above the Gold Coast of Fort Lauderdale on this small-group parasailing adventure and enjoy views you can't get anywhere else. Head out on the water with a captain and crew for a safe experience. Once you’re hundreds of feet in the air, take in views of Lauderdale Beach, the surrounding blue waters of the Atlantic, and even a glimpse of the Bahamas on a very clear day.Enjoy panoramic views as you parasail over the crystal blue waters of the Gold Coast Family-friendly activity for ages five and up Licensed captain with years of parasailing experience Get unique views of the beach from Ideal for groups on Fort Lauderdale's Intracoastal Waterway who want a private captain without handling marina logistics.
